column1: # Where each cloud region is, as its own operator names it (owner, 13 Oct 2026: «saber la ciudad
# o el estado a dónde van… lo máximo que podáis de precisión»). One line per region:
#   proveedor <TAB> región <TAB> ciudad o zona que el operador da <TAB> país <TAB> lat <TAB> lon
# The place is the one in the region's public name (AWS «US East (N. Virginia)», Google
# «us-east4: Ashburn, Virginia», Azure «East US: Virginia», Oracle «US East (Ashburn)»); the
# coordinates are those of that city or, when only a state or area is named, of its usual data
# A region missing here is not placed: build/geo.py lists it and the point stays in its country.
